themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (Uber, Lyft, etc.) spiked to 51 complaints THIS WEEK, a 386% increase versus the 10.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.84), suggesting a sudden concentration of service demand, illegal pickups, or traffic obstruction in Bed-Stuy.
evidence: 51 for-hire vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 10.5 weekly baseline (386% spike, z-score 8.84)
Spike is statistically extreme (z-score above 2.0 threshold indicates rare event)
311 data shows this is newest and sharpest deviation in district this week
reporting_angles: Interview residents on major corridors (Nostrand, Myrtle, Atlantic) about congestion and illegal double-parking by Uber/Lyft drivers
Investigate whether a specific event, venue opening, or service expansion triggered the surge this week

themes_detail.label: Homeless Encampments Surge
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 15 THIS WEEK, a 532% increase from the 2.4 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 6.32), indicating rapid growth of street encampments in Bed-Stuy parks and public spaces.
evidence: 15 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.4 weekly average (532% spike, z-score 6.32)
Converges with repeated community board budget request for expanded homeless services funding
Part of cluster: 15 encampments + 3 park rule violations + 19 animal-in-park complaints (2 weeks ago) suggest park condition deterioration
reporting_angles: Document specific encampment locations (likely Marcy Park, Marcus Garvey, other major parks) and resident concerns about safety/sanitation
Interview DHS and Parks Dept about whether new policy, weather event, or service closure triggered this week's spike

themes_detail.label: Standing Water & Flooding
themes_detail.summary: Standing water complaints spiked to 3 THIS WEEK (2300% increase from 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks, z-score: 8.69), suggesting acute drainage failures, flooding, or stormwater infrastructure breakdown.
evidence: 3 standing water complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2300% spike, z-score 8.69)
Pattern matches with repeated community board requests for DEP infrastructure spending
Converges with high volume of plumbing complaints (630 over 90 days) — may indicate related subsurface infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Identify specific block(s) affected this week — map standing water complaints to storm drains, sewer lines, and recent DOB work permits
Query DEP on whether recent weather, street excavation, or aging infrastructure is causing drainage failure THIS WEEK

themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations & Animal Issues
themes_detail.summary: Over the LAST 2 WEEKS, animal-in-park complaints spiked to 19 (2 weeks ago, 463% increase from 3.4 weekly baseline, z-score: 8.69) and park rule violations jumped to 3 THIS WEEK (1100% increase from 0.2 baseline, z-score: 6.35), pointing to degraded park conditions and enforcement gaps.
evidence: 19 animal-in-park complaints 2 WEEKS AGO (463% spike, z-score 8.69) + 3 park rule violations THIS WEEK (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Converges with repeated CB budget request for new/expanded park amenities and encampment surge
Pattern suggests parks are becoming less safe and enforceable, possibly due to staff/funding shortfalls
reporting_angles: Document which parks are affected (likely Marcy, Marcus Garvey, Prospect Heights) and what animal/violation complaints reveal about conditions
Interview Parks Dept on enforcement capacity and whether encampment-related rule breaks are driving this spike

themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting & Vendor Enforcement
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 3 THIS WEEK (2300% increase from 0.1 weekly average, z-score: 8.69) and vendor enforcement complaints jumped to 3 THIS WEEK (700% increase from 0.4 baseline, z-score: 5.42), suggesting rapid street deregulation or shift in informal economy activity.
evidence: 3 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2300% spike, z-score 8.69)
3 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly baseline (700% spike, z-score 5.42)
Both spikes happened simultaneously THIS WEEK, suggesting possible policy shift or enforcement resource change
reporting_angles: Map illegal posting locations — determine if concentrated on specific corridors or related to event/commercial activity
Interview street vendors and NYPD on whether enforcement has changed or if informal street market is expanding THIS WEEK
